title: Extracts from Thomson’s System of Chemistry, in Foundations of the Atomic Theory
version: Alembic Club Reprints no. 2, Edinburgh and Chicago, 1911; includes Thomson 1807, vol. III, pp. 424–429 and 451–452
lineage: The inspected item is a 1911 reprint of extracts from the 1807 third edition; the original 1807 volume was not directly inspected. Thomson explicitly treated the theory as a hypothesis and cautioned he might have misunderstood it.

passages.note: Reprint pp. 42–48 / source PDF pp. 46–52: Thomson’s exposition and assessment of Dalton’s hypothesis, with conditional numerical applications; reprint p. 42 identifies the 1807 original.

file.method: Selected pages extracted from the 1911 scan; all eight source and excerpt page renders matched at 60 dpi.
